criteria.description: POST /api/favourites with a productId not present in the products table must return HTTP 404 with a JSON body containing an error field.
criteria.evidence: favouritesService.ts::addFavourite contains: `const product = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE id = ?').get(productId); if (!product) { throw new ProductNotFoundError(productId); }` — ProductNotFoundError carries a 404 statusCode and propagates via next(err) through the error handler. All 23 tests passed (including hidden-suite path via supertest); no test failures observed.

criteria.description: Calling POST /api/favourites twice with the same productId must result in exactly one row in the favourites table (idempotent insert), with the second call returning HTTP 200.
criteria.evidence: Visible test 'POST /api/favourites with the same productId is idempotent and returns 200' passed (✓ src/tests/visible/favourites.test.ts > Favourites API — happy path > POST /api/favourites with the same productId is idempotent and returns 200 1ms). favouritesService.ts uses `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO favourites (id, product_id) VALUES (?, ?)` — confirmed atomic single-statement pattern.

criteria.description: DELETE /api/favourites/:productId for a productId with no row in the favourites table must return HTTP 404 with a JSON body containing an error field.
criteria.evidence: favouritesService.ts::removeFavourite returns `result.changes > 0` — when result.changes === 0 (no row found), returns false, causing the controller to return 404 with an error body. Guard is `result.changes > 0` (not `result.changes > -1`), confirmed by file inspection.

criteria.description: SQLite foreign-key constraints are enforced at the DB client level so that the schema-level REFERENCES products(id) on favourites.product_id is active.
criteria.evidence: src/benchmark-backend/src/db/client.ts contains exactly: `db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');` — confirmed by direct file read. The line appears after `db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');`.
